`params["name"]` must be a string with 1 to 50 characters after trimming whitespace, and `params["email"]`
a plausible email address. The handler creates the user with the next free integer id and returns

`(409, {"error": "email already exists"})` when a user with the same email, ignoring case, already exists, and
`(400, {"error": "invalid user"})` for an invalid name or email. A created user must then be retrievable
with `handle_get_user`.

def test_create_user_ok():
    status, user = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"})

    assert status == 201
    assert user["name"] == "Bob"

    handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob3@example.com"})
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Alice", "email": "bob3@example.com"})
    assert status == 409
    assert error == {"error": "email already exists"}

    handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob4@example.com"})
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Alice", "email": "BOB4@EXAMPLE.COM"})
    assert status == 409
    assert error == {"error": "email already exists"}

    status, _ = handle_create_user({"name": "", "email": "bob5@example.com"})
    assert status == 400
    status, _ = handle_create_user({"name": "a" * 51, "email": "bob6@example.com"})
    assert status == 400

    status, _ = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "invalidemail"})
    assert status == 400

from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user, handle_create_user


def test_get_user_ok():
    assert handle_get_user({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"})


def test_get_user_invalid():
    assert handle_get_user({"id": "abc"})[0] == 400


def test_get_user_missing():
    assert handle_get_user({"id": "99"})[0] == 404


def test_create_user_ok():
    status, user = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"})
    assert status == 201
    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
    assert user["email"] == "bob@example.com"
    assert "id" in user
    
    # Verify retrieval
    assert handle_get_user({"id": str(user["id"])}) == (200, user)


def test_create_user_trim_name():
    status, user = handle_create_user({"name": "  Bob  ", "email": "bob2@example.com"})
    assert status == 201
    assert user["name"] == "Bob"


def test_create_user_duplicate_email():
    handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob3@example.com"})
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Alice", "email": "bob3@example.com"})
    assert status == 409
    assert error == {"error": "email already exists"}
